source: Guide for Physicians on Level of Care: Psychiatric

inputs.label: Threat to self (such as severe anxiety, or elopement risk due to capacity issues)

any.text: Threat to self (severe anxiety or elopement risk due to capacity issues)

notes: An inpatient who moves between a psychiatric unit and a medical unit stays inpatient.
observationText: No inpatient criteria met. The guide gives no separate observation criteria for psychiatric issues, so use physician judgment.
